enable_quic_addr_discovery = true
http_bind_addr = "[::]:8080"
metrics_bind_addr = "[::]:9095"

[tls]
hostname = "vps.clerici.tech"
cert_mode = "Reloading"
manual_cert_path = "/tls/tls.crt"
manual_key_path = "/tls/tls.key"
https_bind_addr = "[::]:8444"
quic_bind_addr = "[::]:7842"

set -e
# the kubelet auto-creates a missing file-subPath as a directory;
# remove any such stale dir from earlier runs before seeding
if [ -e /seed/config.json ] && [ ! -f /seed/config.json ]; then
  rm -rf /seed/config.json
fi
if [ ! -f /seed/config.json ]; then
  if [ -f /seed/data/config.json ]; then
    # migrate from the previous layout where config.json lived under data/
    cp /seed/data/config.json /seed/config.json
  else
    cp /app/defaultConfig.json /seed/config.json
  fi
fi

alias ocs='octoprint config set'
ocs --json server.reverseProxy.trustedProxies '["${CLUSTER_POD_CIDR}"]'
ocs webcam.ffmpeg /usr/bin/ffmpeg
ocs plugins.classicwebcam.snapshot "http://octoprint-go2rtc:1984/api/frame.jpeg?src=printer"
ocs plugins.classicwebcam.stream "https://printer-cam.clerici.tech/api/stream.mjpeg?src=printer"
ocs serial.port /dev/serial/by-id/usb-1a86_USB_Serial-if00-port0
